newsitem.title: USA: Nissan lowers suggested prices for Altima.
newsitem.headline: Nissan lowers suggested prices for Altima.

text.p: Nissan Motor Corp USA, a unit of Nissan Motor Co Ltd, said Thursday it lowered the suggested retail price on its new 1998 Nissan Altima by more than $1,500 to $17,990.
The entry-level Altima SE model is priced at $14,990, the sporty Altima SE at $18,490, and the top-of-the-line Altima GLE at $19,890, the company said.
The new Altima models go on sale at 1,100 U.S. dealers on July 10, Nissan said.
The company, which designed the Altima to appeal to luxury car buyers at a modest price, said savings were achieved on development costs and local sourcing at its Tennessee plants.
